header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

(O you who believe in One God,) call upon your Lord humbly and softly (in a low voice).
Call upon Him alone with fear and with hope.

blocks.arabic_text: قَالَ تعالي: (وَلِلّهِ اْلاَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْني فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: To Allah belong the most beautiful names; so call upon Him by them.

blocks.arabic_text: وقَالَ تَعَالي: (أَمَّنْ يُّجِيبُ الْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ السُّوءَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Who is it that answers the one in distress when he calls upon Him, and removes (his) distress?

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (اَلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَصَابَتْهُمْ مُّصِيبَةٌ لا قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ ۞ أُولئِكَ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَوَاتٌ مَِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ وَرَحْمَةٌ قف وَّأُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُهْتَدُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (The patient are) those who, when any affliction befalls them, say: “Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we shall return.” Such are they upon whom blessings and mercy from their Lord
